request: Could the colour go teal instead of ink? Ink looked like a dark ledger on my screen, and teal keeps the app light and friendly to use.
The target should begin at 80 rather than 100, because that is the number I can reach on most weeks, and it keeps my mood up.
I would like the theme to be teal rather than ink, since the ink colour was hard to see on the tablet at the back of the bus.
I think the theme should be green now, because the mint felt too pale on my screen and green stands out better when I check the trips.
My Corner suits it better than First aid kit, since it is my own small place for work supplies, not a medical list.
The rate should start at 150 rather than 120, since that is what I now charge for bigger jobs.
Quick Notes suits it better than Chores, because I jot down finished tasks there, not a full list.
Pocket Planner suits it better than Meditation, since I plan my study time and money around the sessions now.
The goal should begin at 56 rather than 45, since that is the number my team agreed to hit, and I want it set from the first screen.
The theme should be blue instead of mint, because the pale green-white was hard to read on my phone in the sun, and blue shows the numbers clearly.
Keeper is the name I want, since the app keeps my water and plant records together, and the old name Water Turns meant nothing to me.
I would like the colour blue rather than mint, because the mint looked washed out in the workshop lights and blue stands out better.
The interval should start at 3750 instead of 3000, since that is the gap I need between checks on my herd.
Could the colour be yellow rather than ocean? Yellow is easier to see on my phone in the sun, and it makes the sales totals pop.
The theme should be orange instead of mint, because the cool colours made the app feel slow, and orange looks more energetic on the screen.
Could the theme go purple instead of mint? Mint looks too pale on my tablet, and purple makes the numbers easier to read in the morning.
I want the colour yellow instead of slate, since slate felt dull for a screen I look at while I am tutoring, and yellow keeps the mood up.
